test: Network-constrained V2G TxProfile: OCPP 2.1 CentralSetpoint clamped to CSIP-AUS site limits
timezone: AEDT (UTC+11), Canberra; all times below are local
station: SIM-EV-EVEREST-V2G-03 (EVerest DC V2G Test Charger 0.1.11, ISO 15118-20 DC_BPT, 25 kW both ways)
csms: CitrineOS Isolated Lab 0.7.1 (CitrineOS v2.0.1) on the Green

network_constraint.source: Cactus CSIP-AUS run 75143 (ALL-25-EXT), DERC1 via Open Dynamic Export

site_model.pv: Open-Meteo Solar Forecast, house arrays (8.5 kWp east, 15 kWp west) at the Green's home location, capped at the 15 kW inverters/1 nameplate, curtailed so site export stays within opModExpLimW / 1.05
site_model.note: Site values are computed from the model's mean values at the CSMS-measured EV power, before the +/-5% random variation; the live site meter is published on MQTT every 10 s and is not recorded in Home Assistant.

dispatch.rule: Requested setpoints are clamped to the site headroom before sending. Discharge headroom = 0.98 x export limit - worst-case PV export (PV keeps priority on the export limit). Charge headroom = 0.98 x import limit + 0.95 x (least PV - most house load) - test load.
